content.short: Go is a popular backend language that powers and expands logic for many EVM smart contracts.
content.description: Go originated as a Google internal project to solve concurrency and SRE issues, and is now the backend language behind many cloud web applications. Developers building scalable apps can use Go's concise syntax to create maintainable codebases. Go has a large and active developer community for support.
content.meta: Go is a backend language created by Google to address concurrency and reliability concerns. Discover Go and other Web3 Developer Tools on Lancers Web3 Explorer.

resources.tldr: Execution traces became far more powerful in 2024. The flight recorder is what that unlocked: capturing the trace only when it matters.
